findings.title: Missing Schema.org Organization structured data on root landing page
findings.evidence:
Observed at https://www.iana.org/ via jsonld_schema_extractor [2026-08-31T19:40:27Z]: Root homepage contains 0 Organization or LocalBusiness JSON-LD schema blocks. (Confidence: high)
Additional evidence (citation-simulator): Observed at https://www.iana.org via onsite_answerability_probe [2026-08-31T19:40:28Z]: Across 5 crawled page(s), no Organization/LocalBusiness schema states who the brand is in machine-readable form. An assistant that fetched these pages could not quote an answer to "What is Internet Assigned Numbers Authority?" from this site, so it must fall back to third-party sources or omit the brand. (Confidence: medium)

suggested_action.summary: Add Organization JSON-LD markup to the homepage.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Add a JSON-LD script on the homepage declaring @type 'Organization' with name, url, logo, and sameAs links to authoritative profiles.

evidence_details.observation: Root homepage contains 0 Organization or LocalBusiness JSON-LD schema blocks.

findings.title: Brand identity is not anchored to any independent authority source
findings.evidence: Observed at https://www.iana.org via onsite_identity_anchor_inspection [2026-08-31T19:40:28Z]: Across the crawled pages, no Organization schema is present, so no sameAs URIs can be declared, and 0 of 2 distinct outbound link domains point to an independent authority (Wikipedia, Wikidata, Crunchbase, LinkedIn, GitHub, regulatory registries). An assistant resolving "Internet Assigned Numbers Authority" therefore has no machine-readable route from this site to a corroborating third party, and no way to tell it apart from other entities sharing the name. (Confidence: high)

suggested_action.summary: Publish machine-readable identity anchors linking the brand to independent authorities.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Add Organization JSON-LD with a stable @id, legalName, and a sameAs array pointing to the brand's Wikidata item, Wikipedia article, LinkedIn company page and Crunchbase profile. Create those external profiles first if they do not exist -- sameAs pointing at nothing does not corroborate anything.

evidence_details.observation: Across the crawled pages, no Organization schema is present, so no sameAs URIs can be declared, and 0 of 2 distinct outbound link domains point to an independent authority (Wikipedia, Wikidata, Crunchbase, LinkedIn, GitHub, regulatory registries). An assistant resolving "Internet Assigned Numbers Authority" therefore has no machine-readable route from this site to a corroborating third party, and no way to tell it apart from other entities sharing the name.

findings.title: No site search affordance found on any crawled page
findings.evidence: Observed at https://www.iana.org via search_affordance_detection [2026-08-31T19:40:27Z]: None of the 5 crawled pages expose a search input, a search form or role="search". A visitor who arrives on the wrong page from an AI answer has no way to find the right one without returning to the assistant. (Confidence: medium)

suggested_action.summary: Add a site search box to the persistent header.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Add a search input in the global header and expose it with role="search". Add WebSite JSON-LD with a potentialAction SearchAction so assistants can surface your search directly.

evidence_details.observation: None of the 5 crawled pages expose a search input, a search form or role="search". A visitor who arrives on the wrong page from an AI answer has no way to find the right one without returning to the assistant.

findings.title: No returning-visitor or account affordance detected
findings.evidence: Observed at https://www.iana.org via returning_visitor_affordance_detection [2026-08-31T19:40:27Z]: Across 5 crawled pages there is no sign-in, account, saved-items or recently-viewed affordance in the visible text. Every visitor is therefore treated as anonymous and first-time, so nothing the brand already knows about a returning visitor can shape what they are shown. (Confidence: medium)

suggested_action.summary: Give returning visitors a way to be recognised, and use it.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Add an account or saved-state affordance appropriate to the site (sign-in, saved items, recently viewed, or a lightweight preference stored locally), then use it to surface relevant content on return rather than resetting every visitor to a cold start.

evidence_details.observation: Across 5 crawled pages there is no sign-in, account, saved-items or recently-viewed affordance in the visible text. Every visitor is therefore treated as anonymous and first-time, so nothing the brand already knows about a returning visitor can shape what they are shown.

proactive_recommendations.title: Publish an llms.txt file to guide AI assistants to authoritative documentation
proactive_recommendations.rationale: Emerging AI web standards like /llms.txt provide large language models with a curated, markdown-formatted directory of core brand documentation and APIs.

suggested_action.summary: Create an llms.txt file in the root web directory.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Add an /llms.txt file containing markdown links to your primary product, documentation, pricing, and company overview pages.
